title: Concept: Image tag carrying an onerror handler
description: An img element with an inline onerror handler in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The handler runs whenever the image fails to load, so a broken or blocked source is enough to execute script that arrived with the markup.
applicability: Deployments that render an img element with an inline onerror handler into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The handler runs whenever the image fails to load, so a broken or blocked source is enough to execute script that arrived with the markup.
